title: Machine and Signal Anew
author: Freya Fairweather
blurb: Beatrix Crane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
